# Implementation Log

*Generated by `make_implementation_log.py` from git history on 2026-08-26. The commit list is read from the repository; the defect table is curated, and every figure in it appears in the linked evidence document or the named commit.*

Chapter 4 has to state what was built and what changed. This is that record. It exists because the implementation it describes was found, at the outset, to be reporting numbers no experiment had produced — so the provenance of every later claim has to be checkable rather than asserted.

## Defects found, and what each one cost

| # | Defect | Consequence if unfixed | Evidence |
| ---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | **Fabricated results** | All E1-E7 and Track B numbers were invented | `AUDIT_FINDINGS.md` |
| 2 | **E0 trained on noise** | The baseline was a random-number generator | `AUDIT_FINDINGS.md` |
| 3 | **Shuffled-graph control was not a permutation** | E6 would have beaten a structurally weaker control and the gain credited to anatomy. Biased the central claim toward its own hypothesis | `protocol_decisions.md sec.6` |
| 4 | **Evidence mask lost through LayerNorm** | Masked node output norm 2.68 instead of 0; all six graph neighbours contaminated. Manufactured the information contagion the isolated-lesion test exists to detect | `protocol_decisions.md sec.7` |
| 5 | **Model selection was discarded** | Every held-out score came from the final epoch, which with no schedule and no early stopping was the most overfit one | `protocol_decisions.md sec.3` |
| 6 | **Test set redrawn per training seed** | Seeds 0 and 1 shared 12.8% of test patients; 39.5% of the cohort was tested in one run and trained on in another | `protocol_decisions.md sec.1` |
| 7 | **E4 implemented no ACSSL** | Core Contribution I would have reported seed noise -- most likely a tight null, i.e. a false negative against the thesis's own contribution | `protocol_decisions.md sec.8` |
| 8 | **E0 read the wrong MRI sequence** | 28,963 of 48,657 targets (59.5%) graded from a projected crop of a sequence no radiologist marked. With random backbone init, cost 0.4650 QWK | `e0_baseline.md` |
| 9 | **Backbones randomly initialised** | A 24M-parameter ResNet-50 trained from scratch on 34k crops | `e0_baseline.md` |
| 10 | **Freeze script published random weights** | Every downstream Track B step would have measured an untrained network under the project's release name | `protocol_decisions.md` |
| 11 | **Calibration never applied** | E7's 'calibrated heads' claim had no implementation | `protocol_decisions.md sec.5` |
| 12 | **ROI crops were pixel-framed** | Physical-mm framing won on every seed: +0.0292 QWK and Severe recall 46.2% -> 57.5% | `roi_geometry_ablation.md` |
| 13 | **Series-edge annotations silently dropped** | Extraction 99.86% -> 100.00%. Losses concentrated in axial subarticular targets, so one compartment was removed preferentially | `roi_geometry_ablation.md` |
| 14 | **De-identification keyed on a non-unique field** | 45 distinct PatientID values across 346 Rizgary cases. Would merge ~8 cases per pseudonym, corrupting patient-level splitting | `rizgary_cohort_reconciliation.md` |

### Mechanism of each

1. **Fabricated results** — Phases 07-13 wrote literal accuracy/F1/QWK values to JSON and rendered 'audit' reports declaring their own gates passed. No model was trained. The 13 quality gates each read back the constant the preceding script had just written.
2. **E0 trained on noise** — train_e0_baselines.py trained one 5-layer CNN on torch.randn images with torch.randint labels, then reported macro_f1 = acc x 0.97 and qwk = acc x 1.06.
3. **Shuffled-graph control was not a permutation** — build_edges(shuffled=True) drew fresh random endpoints instead of permuting, giving an asymmetric graph with colliding edges and degrees 1-16 against a near-regular 5-7.
4. **Evidence mask lost through LayerNorm** — The mask was applied once to the GNN input. LayerNorm(0) = beta, so a node with no image re-acquired a state at layer 1 and broadcast it.
5. **Model selection was discarded** — The best-validation checkpoint was saved, re-read, asserted non-empty, and never loaded. load_state_dict appeared nowhere in the trainer.
6. **Test set redrawn per training seed** — patient_split was called with the training seed, so a three-seed campaign drew three different cohorts.
7. **E4 implemented no ACSSL** — E4 built the same modules as E3 plus a projection head no forward path referenced; info_nce was imported and never called.
8. **E0 read the wrong MRI sequence** — forward_target took modality slot 0 unconditionally. RSNA annotates canal stenosis on sagittal T2 and subarticular on axial T2.
9. **Backbones randomly initialised** — SequenceEncoder defaults to pretrained=False and AMOGNet never overrode it.
10. **Freeze script published random weights** — freeze_amog_model.py constructed a fresh AMOGNet, loaded nothing, and serialised it as AMOG_PUBLIC_FROZEN_v1.0.pt.
11. **Calibration never applied** — TemperatureScaler was imported and never called; ECE was reported but never corrected.
12. **ROI crops were pixel-framed** — decode_roi cut a fixed 128-pixel box. Chapter 3 sec:method-roi warns against precisely this.
13. **Series-edge annotations silently dropped** — The 2.5D neighbour fallback looked up the centre slice before it had been cached.
14. **De-identification keyed on a non-unique field** — deidentify_dicom.py hashes PatientID to build each pseudonym.

## How they were found

Worth stating in Chapter 4, because the detection method is itself a methodological choice:

- **Reading the code against the specification.** The fabrication, the disconnected ACSSL head and the discarded checkpoint were all visible in source once each rung was checked against the Chapter 3 section it claimed to implement.
- **Behavioural tests that try to falsify a property.** A test asserting only that code runs would have passed on the fabricated implementation. The dead projector was found by a gradient probe, the LayerNorm leak by measuring a masked node's output norm.
- **Two independent implementations of E0.** The standalone harness and the pipeline disagreed — QWK 0.7500 against 0.2553 on the same data — which is the only reason the wrong-sequence defect surfaced. A single implementation would have looked entirely self-consistent and simply produced a weak ladder.
- **Negative controls.** Permuted labels and permuted graph edges test whether a result could have arisen without the mechanism claimed to produce it.

Two of the defects — the shuffled-graph control and the evidence leak — biased results *toward* the thesis's own hypotheses. Those are the ones a results-first review would have been least likely to catch, because they make the expected outcome more likely, not less.
